sloka: हा राघव महा बाहो हा मम आयास नाशन ।हा पितृप्रिय मे नाथ हाद्य क्वासि गतः सुत ॥२-६४-७६॥
transliteration: hā rāghava mahā bāho hā mama āyāsa nāśana ।hā pitṛpriya me nātha hādya kvāsi gataḥ suta ॥2-64-76॥

translations.english: Ah, mightyarmed Rama, destroyer of my agonies, Ah, the delight of your father, Ah, my protector, Ah, my son, where have you gone?.
